pteropus approved · Reviewer

Approving modulo the CJK fixture. Non-blocking thoughts:

def shrink(widths, budget):
    """Proportional shrink with per-column floor — reference for the Go port."""
    while sum(widths) + 3 * len(widths) + 1 > budget:
        widest = max(range(len(widths)), key=lambda i: widths[i])
        if widths[widest] <= 3:
            raise ValueError("cannot shrink further")
        widths[widest] -= 1
    return widths
